name: Sphere Pullbacks over a Fixed Convex Section
statement: There are fixed contractible coefficient spaces $\mathcal A(B)$ and $\mathcal A(D)$ and, for every even $m\ge4$, a contractible $\mathcal A(E_m)$ with open surjections $f:\mathcal A(B)\to\mathcal A(D)$ and $g_m:\mathcal A(E_m)\to\mathcal A(D)$ whose strict fiber product is homotopy equivalent to $S^{m-2}$. The section $D$ has 22 concepts and $\mathcal A(D)=\Delta_3^\circ\times\Delta_3^\circ\times\Delta_1^\circ$; $B$ has 31 concepts and is independent of $m$.
proof: Split the directed even-cycle construction into a fixed length-two path and its complementary path, meeting in the two endpoints. Acyclicity makes both path coefficient spaces contractible, while exact coefficient-space gluing identifies the cycle space with their strict pullback times $(0,1)^{m-3}$. The cycle-space computation has sphere type $S^{m-2}$. Prescribed endpoint rows extend along either path by choosing intermediate log positions with a positive increment on one control, proving both restriction maps surjective; they are open coordinate projections of relatively open sets.
comments: The ordinary homotopy pullback is contractible because the base is convex, so its comparison with the strict pullback is not a homotopy equivalence. Objectwise homotopy types and extension images therefore do not determine coefficient-space gluing.
